options.content:
## FT Pipeline Dashboard

**Live sections:** LLM interaction collection (V0002), Phase 10 benchmark history (V0012 `benchmark_runs`/`benchmark_results`), LLM endpoint health (V0018, Phase 13.5 watchdog).

**TSDB-CONSUME-001 (2026-06-11):** the Model Version Timeline, Benchmark Scores, Training Cycle History, and Exogenous Ratio panels were **removed** — they read `ft_model_versions` / `ft_benchmarks` / `ft_training_cycles`, which have **no writer** (0 rows ever). The tables remain: they are the designated sinks for the FT recursive-retraining loop (FT Phases 6/7/9 — NOT STARTED; trigger: FT-CLASSIFY-002). Restore the panels from git history when that loop ships writers.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time,
  COUNT(*) / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '$__interval'::interval) AS rate
FROM llm_interactions
WHERE space_id = '$space_id'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Phase 10 Benchmark — Per-Task Pass Rate (latest run)
panels.description: Reads benchmark_results (V0012). Score = mean of deterministic reward_vector entries across N runs per task, for the most recent run_id.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT run_id FROM benchmark_runs
  ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
),
per_row AS (
  SELECT
    br.task_id,
    br.sampling_group,
    br.run_idx,
    (
      SELECT AVG((v)::float)
      FROM jsonb_each_text(br.reward_vector) AS kv(k, v)
      WHERE v ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
    ) AS row_scalar
  FROM benchmark_results br
  JOIN latest l ON br.run_id = l.run_id
)
SELECT
  task_id,
  MAX(sampling_group) AS sampling_group,
  COUNT(*) AS n_runs,
  ROUND(AVG(row_scalar)::numeric, 4) AS mean_score,
  ROUND(MIN(row_scalar)::numeric, 4) AS min_score,
  ROUND(MAX(row_scalar)::numeric, 4) AS max_score
FROM per_row
GROUP BY task_id
ORDER BY task_id

panels.title: Phase 10 Benchmark — Per-Task Reward Variance (stddev)
panels.description: Reads benchmark_results (V0012). Stddev of the per-run scalar reward across N runs for each task in the most recent benchmark — Phase 11 GRPO uses this as advantage-normalization denominator.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT run_id FROM benchmark_runs
  ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
),
per_row AS (
  SELECT
    br.task_id,
    br.run_idx,
    (
      SELECT AVG((v)::float)
      FROM jsonb_each_text(br.reward_vector) AS kv(k, v)
      WHERE v ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
    ) AS row_scalar
  FROM benchmark_results br
  JOIN latest l ON br.run_id = l.run_id
)
SELECT
  task_id AS metric,
  ROUND(COALESCE(STDDEV_POP(row_scalar), 0)::numeric, 4) AS value
FROM per_row
GROUP BY task_id
ORDER BY task_id

panels.title: Phase 10 Benchmark — Stagnation Flag (latest)
panels.description: Reads benchmark_runs.stagnation_flag for the most recent run. Phase 10 informational-only; becomes blocking in Phase 11 once benchmark_runs count >= 3.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  started_at AS time,
  CASE WHEN stagnation_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value
FROM benchmark_runs
ORDER BY started_at DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Phase 10 Benchmark — Aggregate Weighted Score (history)
panels.description: Reads benchmark_runs.aggregate_weighted_score over time. Group-weighted score (T:0.50 / C:0.35 / J:0.15). Stagnation threshold = |delta| < 0.005 across last 3.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  started_at AS time,
  aggregate_weighted_score AS value,
  model_path AS metric
FROM benchmark_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
ORDER BY started_at

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time,
  AVG(quality) AS value
FROM llm_interactions
WHERE quality IS NOT NULL
  AND space_id = '$space_id'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: LLM endpoint state (0=up, 1=degraded, 2=down)
panels.description: Watchdog state machine over time. Each row in llm_endpoint_health_events records a state transition; the line shows the active state between transitions.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recorded_at AS time, state_numeric AS value, endpoint_url AS metric FROM llm_endpoint_health_events WHERE event_kind IN ('state_transition', 'probe_recovery') AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) ORDER BY recorded_at

panels.title: State transitions in window
panels.description: Count of watchdog state changes (up↔degraded↔down) in selected time range. Steady state should be 0; transitions indicate endpoint instability.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM llm_endpoint_health_events WHERE event_kind = 'state_transition' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at)

panels.title: Fast-fail bursts in window
panels.description: Number of 30s windows where the llmclient fast-fail gate engaged (i.e. caller asked for an LLM while watchdog state was Down). Each row aggregates short-circuits in its window; rows = bursts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM llm_endpoint_health_events WHERE event_kind = 'fast_fail_burst' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at)

panels.title: Recent watchdog events (last 30 in window)
panels.description: Forensic view: when did each transition happen, what error triggered it, what was the state machine doing. probe_recovery rows mark down→up healing events; fast_fail_burst rows mark llmclient short-circuit windows.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recorded_at AS "time", endpoint_url, event_kind, from_state, to_state, state_numeric, consecutive_failures, burst_short_circuits, LEFT(COALESCE(error_message, ''), 120) AS error FROM llm_endpoint_health_events WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 30
